series: What if the countries were swapped?
title: What if Harry Kane was French?
checked: Kane: 91 England goals (record), 125th cap v Czechia 6 Oct 2026 equals Shilton (AP via News4Jax, Bundesliga.com); debut March 2015 (Wikipedia, England Football). Heartbreaks: 2018 WC semi (Croatia), Euro 2020 final lost on penalties to Italy, Euro 2024 final lost 2-1 to Spain, 2026 WC semi lost 2-1 to Argentina (Wikipedia, worldcupranking, UNN). 2022 QF England 1-2 France, Al Bayt, 10 Dec 2022; Kane scored one penalty and put the second over the bar at 84' (Wikipedia, BBC). France since 2015: Euro 2016 final lost to Portugal, 2018 WC won 4-2 v Croatia in Moscow, 2021 Nations League won, 2022 WC final 3-3 lost 4-2 on penalties (Wikipedia, 11v11, UEFA). The Kane-for-France goal is an imagined alternate world and is labelled so. England 6-4 France third-place score left out (one source only). Gameplay: gamecap specs ns-kane-england (real miss) and ns-kane-france (alternate).

lines.text: Ninety-one goals for England, and not one trophy. What if Harry Kane had been French?
Real world first. Kane is England's record scorer, and in October he equalled Shilton's caps record.
lines.say: Real world first. Kane is England's record scorer, and in October he equalled Shilton's caps record.

lines.text: But the big nights keep ending the same way. Semi-final, final, final, semi-final.
And the worst of all: Qatar, 2022. Two-one down to France. A penalty to level it, and Kane puts it over the bar.
lines.say: And the worst of all: Qatar, twenty twenty-two. Two-one down to France. A penalty to level it, and Kane puts it over the bar.

lines.text: England went out. France went on.

scene.note: Kane scored one penalty and missed the second

lines.text: Now the alternate world. Same years, but Kane wears the blue of France.
In 2018, France win the World Cup, four-two against Croatia in Moscow.
lines.say: In twenty eighteen, France win the World Cup, four-two against Croatia in Moscow.

scene.note: Champions of the world for the second time

lines.text: Then the Nations League in 2021. That's two trophies Kane never got.
lines.say: Then the Nations League in twenty twenty-one. That's two trophies Kane never got.

lines.text: And in Qatar's final, France drew three-three with Argentina, and lost on penalties.

scene.note: Mbappé hat-trick · Argentina win 4-2 on penalties

lines.text: In our world, it's the last minute of extra time. Griezmann crosses, and Kane heads the winner.
lines.say: In our world, it's the last minute of extra time. Greezman crosses, and Kane heads the winner.

lines.text: Real Kane: zero trophies. French Kane: two, maybe three. And no penalty in Qatar to miss.
Would you swap ninety-one England goals for a World Cup? Tell us in the comments.
